stories.title: La propuesta para que Colau lidere el Frente Amplio en las generales reabre el debate sobre el encaje de Podemos

en.title: Proposal for Colau to lead Broad Front in general elections reopens debate on Podemos's fit
en.summary: Political parties are seeking a global agreement before officially announcing their candidacy for general elections, with a proposal for Colau to lead the Broad Front coalition sparking discussion about Podemos's role.

stories.title: El caos se enquista en Rodalies con un nuevo pulso de los maquinistas

en.title: Chaos entrenches itself in Rodalies with a new confrontation by train drivers
en.summary: A union is demanding new safety tests following severe weather, causing disruptions to short-distance train services in Catalonia.

stories.title: Los líderes políticos reaccionan al fallecimiento del símbolo de los desahuciados: “La muerte de Maricarmen nos golpea”

en.title: Political leaders react to the death of the symbol of the evicted: "Maricarmen's death hits us hard"
en.summary: Political representatives have shared condolences on social media following the death of an elderly Madrid woman, calling for measures to prevent similar cases of eviction.

stories.title: Nobel de Química para Henri Kagan y Kenso Soai por imitar la asimetría de la vida

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry for Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for imitating life's asymmetry
en.summary: Two chemists received the Nobel Prize for their work on molecular asymmetry, addressing how organisms preferentially use one version of chiral molecules, a challenge long central to drug development.

stories.title: La izquierda convierte el fallecimiento de Maricarmen en un icono electoral: "No es una muerte, es un asesinato"

en.title: The left converts Maricarmen's death into an electoral icon: "It is not a death, it is a murder"
en.summary: Left-wing politicians are using the death of an 87-year-old woman as a political symbol. The Prime Minister expressed sympathy for those who feel this loss personally.

stories.title: Masivo duelo de los acampados de Sol ante el Congreso por Maricarmen: "¡Vergüenza!"

en.title: Massive vigil by Sol tent residents before Congress for Maricarmen: "Shame!"
en.summary: Protesters gathered at Sol encampment demonstrated before Congress, chanting accusations against landlords and expressing outrage over Maricarmen's death.

stories.title: “Maricarmen tiene que ser la última víctima del sistema”: cientos de acampados marchan desde Sol al Congreso

en.title: "Maricarmen must be the last victim of the system": hundreds of campers march from Sol to Congress
en.summary: Hundreds of protesters from the Sol encampment marched to Congress following the death of Maricarmen, shouting slogans demanding that she be the last victim of the housing system.

stories.title: Maricarmen murió horas antes de firmar su contrato de alquiler para ocho años y recuperar su casa

en.title: Maricarmen died hours before signing her eight-year rental contract and recovering her home
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman died in a Madrid hospital hours before she was scheduled to sign a rental agreement that would have allowed her to return to her home.

stories.title: Los acampados en Sol marchan hacia el Congreso en homenaje a Maricarmen: “No son muertes, son asesinatos”

en.title: Protesters camped at Sol march toward Congress in tribute to Maricarmen: "These are not deaths, they are murders"
en.summary: Demonstrators at a Madrid plaza camp have marched to Congress to honor an elderly woman who became a symbol of housing rights activism. Her death has prompted shock among protesters gathered at the central location.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen Abascal a los 87 años, dos semanas después del desahucio de su casa de Madrid

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal dies at 87, two weeks after her Madrid home eviction
en.summary: An elderly woman with disabilities was evicted from her home on September 23 and hospitalized, but later reached an agreement to return. She has since died at age 87.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, la mujer que encendió la lucha contra los desahucios en España

en.title: Maricarmen, the woman who sparked the fight against evictions in Spain, dies
en.summary: An 87-year-old activist who led efforts against housing evictions in Spain passed away at a Madrid hospital, according to tenants' union confirmation.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, símbolo de la lucha antidesahucios

en.title: Maricarmen dies, symbol of the anti-eviction movement
en.summary: An octogenarian who was evicted from her Madrid apartment in September has died in hospital, where she had been admitted since the eviction.

stories.title: Electrificar aviones o barcos es difícil, hacen falta moléculas verdes

en.title: Electrifying aircraft or ships is difficult, green molecules are needed
en.summary: Electrification presents significant challenges for aviation and maritime transport, requiring alternative fuel technologies for decarbonization.

stories.title: Aena pausa su crecimiento en Brasil tras incorporar Río-Galeão

en.title: Aena pauses its growth in Brazil after incorporating Rio-Galeão
en.summary: Aena has incorporated Rio-Galeão airport and is pausing its expansion efforts in Brazil.

stories.title: El presidente de Burger King negocia aliarse con Galán y Costa para pujar por el grupo

en.title: President of Burger King negotiates alliance with Galán and Costa to bid for the group
en.summary: The president and second shareholder of RBE is forming a consortium with other investors to attempt purchasing a controlling stake in the company from Cinven.

stories.title: El fondo USS ficha a Deutsche Bank para decidir el futuro de Redexis

en.title: USS fund hires Deutsche Bank to decide the future of Redexis
en.summary: USS and ATP have engaged Deutsche Bank to help decide within a month whether to acquire a stake in Redexis or divest their holdings.

stories.title: Nuevo marco para la vivienda: así queda el mercado residencial tras la entrada en vigor del decreto

en.title: New framework for housing: how the residential market stands after decree enters into force
en.summary: New housing regulations including rental extensions, eviction protections, and tax incentives have become effective ahead of congressional approval.
